data.highlights: Text highlights are primarily handled via color contrast (e.g., text-primary for emphasis) and opacity shifts (text-foreground-lighter).
insights: The typography system utilizes a dual-family strategy: Manrope for expressive headings (via var(--font-heading)) and Inter for body text, creating a strong distinction between display and content.
Utility classes (e.g., text-xs, text-sm, text-4xl) are heavily relied upon for responsive scaling, indicating a Tailwind-based structural approach.
The toast notification system utilizes an independent, highly defensive system-UI font stack with fixed pixel values (12px/13px) to ensure absolute OS-native legibility for critical alerts.
